notes.title: Major Changes Coming to Loot and Stats!
notes.content:
Loot will be receiving a facelift in the next update for the Shadows of Morhaven demo

Hey Kingsguard! 
Base stats have been tweaked for each item, and rarity of the item will now determine how much said base stats will scale, with Common items receiving base values, and Legendary items receiving +60% on base values.
This means that a shortsword, for example, with a base of 25 STR will receive a +15, making it 40 STR at Legendary rarity.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45399362/a06e9d304de34dd15c66ac515940ace1a2fe4b26.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45399362/b92eed85ecf2a472e6313148d6309100788c88fe.jpg
See the above images for a comparison of a Common vs Legendary shortsword.

Additionally, as you can see in the above images, each stat roll will have it's own randomly selected tier, ranging from 1-5. Each tier has progressively higher possible values, but are consequentially more rare. In the above image, There were 3 stat rolls, with one receiving the lowest tier, T1. There is one T2, and one T3. Each tier has a range of bonuses that can be awarded, with the caps increasing with each tier.

I think this is a step in the right direction toward making loot more exciting, while also adding a bit more RNG to keep things interesting.

I'd love to hear your feedback in the replies on this post, or in the Discord server. 

Thanks for reading!
-Casey AKA QuestDev

notes.title: Shadows of Morhaven Joins NextFest – Updated Demo Available Now!
notes.content:
Greetings, adventurers!

I'm very thrilled to announce that Shadows of Morhaven is officially part of Steam NextFest! I encourage you to head over to the demo page where you can experience the latest demo update, featuring new content, bug fixes, and gameplay improvements tailored to fix up and improve the game based on a ton of community feedback since it's release.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45399362/07789fc5b1c431fc471b3b477804138cdac29912.jpg

This is your chance to step into the dark and mysterious world of Morhaven, battle fearsome gobbies (any perhaps more!), and uncover the sinister forces lurking in the shadows. Whether you're a returning player or diving in for the first time, this updated demo brings enhanced combat, refined mechanics, and a few surprises along the way.

💀 What’s New in the NextFest Demo?

 Improved combat responsiveness and balancing
 Improvements to merchants and the in-game economy
 LOTS of Bug fixes and performance enhancements
 And more!


I'd love to hear your feedback
Join the discussion in the community hub or in the community Discord server and let us know what you think!

Don’t miss your chance to play and wishlist Shadows of Morhaven today.

🔗 Wishlist the game here

— Casey AKA QuestDev
